fusions.name: Flyby Nip
fusions.desc: A bite taken in passing that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. You move 8% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Shrieking Descent
fusions.desc: Swoops you to a target up to 6 tiles away and shrieks. The shriek deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to turn each one on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lamps Out
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sounding Ahead
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a shriek finds the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
